import networkx as nx
G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(6))
G.add_edge(3, 5)
# Add edges to make the graph maximal triangle-free
for i in range(6):
    for j in range(i + 1, 6):
        if (i, j) != (3, 5) and not G.has_edge(i, j):
            G.add_edge(i, j)
            # Check if the graph still has no triangles
            if len(list(nx.find_cycle(G))) > 0:
                G.remove_edge(i, j)
# Return the list of edges
print([(u, v) for u, v in G.edges()])
